يبتعثوا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَعِثُوا (yabtaʕiṯū) /jab.ta.ʕi.θuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# يُبْتَعَثُوا (yubtaʕaṯū) /jub.ta.ʕa.θuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
